name: Host header carries an unbracketed IPv6 literal (malformed authority) while the URL is clean
spec_reference: #adcp-rfc-9421-profile (@authority derived from the as-received Host header and canonicalized by the URL canonicalization algorithm; malformed authority → request_target_uri_malformed)
$comment: The URL is the valid bracketed form https://[::1]/..., and the Signature is a real Ed25519 signature by test-ed25519-2026 over the base computed from the URL authority '[::1]', so the Host header is the only fault. The profile derives @authority from the as-received Host header and canonicalizes it by the same algorithm as @target-uri; an IPv6 literal outside brackets ('::1') is ambiguous with a port and is malformed (canonicalization.json case malformed-bare-ipv6), so the verifier MUST reject with request_target_uri_malformed at step 10. A verifier that derives @authority from the URL alone never judges the header, computes the signed base, verifies the signature, and wrongly accepts. failed_step is informational: step 10 is where @authority derivation happens; grading is on the error code.
